name: Price Format 66 Choice
definition: Choice between a percentage price or an amount price or an unspecified price or an amount price per amount or an amount price per financial instrument quantity.

AmountPrice.name: Amount Price
AmountPrice.definition: Price expressed as a currency and amount.

NotSpecifiedPrice.name: Not Specified Price
NotSpecifiedPrice.definition: Value of the price not specified.

AmountPricePerFinancialInstrumentQuantit.name: Amount Price Per Financial Instrument Quantity
AmountPricePerFinancialInstrumentQuantit.definition: Price expressed as a ratio: amount price per financial instrument quantity.

AmountPricePerAmount.name: Amount Price Per Amount
AmountPricePerAmount.definition: Price expressed as a ratio: amount price per amount.
